title: FOMC meeting begins (Oct 26-27, no SEP) — day one is the October 2027 Consumer Confidence print
source: EST: federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm, fetched direct 2026-09-06 by this session (HTTP 200, 164,831 bytes) and re-parsed panel by panel. The 2027 panel reads verbatim "January 26-27 | March 16-17* | April 27-28 | June 8-9* | July 27-28 | September 14-15* | October 26-27 | December 7-8*" under the page's own footnote "* Meeting associated with a Summary of Economic Projections" -- so October 26-27 carries NO SEP. Oct 26 2027 is a Tuesday and Oct 27 a Wednesday, consistent with the two-day convention. NOTE THE FILE NAME: every other fomc-* entry in this calendar is named by its DECISION day, which here would be 2027-10-27. This one is deliberately named by day one, because day one is the event that matters to the proposer -- it is the Consumer Confidence release date -- and because the decision leg is the taking lane's to name. Whoever adopts this id should decide whether to rename it to fomc-2027-10-27 for consistency or keep the day-one anchor; the proposal states the conflict rather than silently picking. The parse was assertion-checked before anything downstream was trusted, using the trap two sibling ledgers banked: expanding the abbreviated cross-month labels (Jan/Feb 31-1, Apr/May 30-1, Oct/Nov 31-1) AND consuming them before the full-month pattern runs returns 56 meetings, exactly 8 in each of the seven years 2021-2027, and 17 CB-day collisions in the tape window -- all three assertions the siblings recorded. BYTE-COUNT NOTE, CORRECTING A SIBLING: the consumer-confidence-2027-09-28 lane recorded this page at 166,936 bytes on this same date and concluded it is "not the stable artifact the chain has treated it as". This session got 164,831, matching the five ledgers that recorded that figure, so six of seven fetches on 2026-09-06 agree and the 166,936 reading was the outlier. Filed estimate not for want of a primary but because the same page states verbatim "Each meeting date is tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it" -- the confirming venue is the 2027-09-14/15 meeting. The 14:00 ET statement time is the standing convention and is not on this page. Discovered during the consumer-confidence-2027-10-26 initial research, checked 2026-09-06
notes: DISCOVERED during the consumer-confidence-2027-10-26 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-06), and proposed because it is the only zero-distance adjacency this calendar has ever had for a CB print and because a structural finding in that ledger has no home without it. FOUR THINGS FOR WHOEVER TAKES THIS ID. (1) THIS MEETING CANNOT HAVE A SEP, AND THAT IS ARITHMETIC. Across all 28 SEP meetings in the 2021-2027 panel the day-one date falls between the 7th and the 21st of its month (median the 15th/16th); the last Tuesday of any month falls between the 22nd and the 31st. The ranges cannot overlap, and a two-day meeting's day two is always a Wednesday. So a Consumer Confidence print can only ever collide with a NON-SEP meeting -- which is exactly what the record shows, 17 of 17 collisions in the tape window and all four of 2027's (01-26, 04-27, 07-27, 10-26). The margin is a single day (21 vs 22), so this is falsifiable rather than a theorem: a SEP meeting scheduled with day one on the 22nd or later breaks it. (2) THE CB LANE HAS ALREADY MEASURED THE TRANSMISSION QUESTION THREE WAYS AND FOUND NOTHING, so a rates lane should not inherit an assumption the equity tape refuses. Print-day collision, 0 of 9 (the 08-31 sibling). Decision inside the print's survey panel, 0 of 9 at n=16 vs 35 (the 09-28 sibling). Release inside the communications blackout, 0 of 9 at n=23 vs 45 (this lane, new). Within October alone, clean CB days vs colliding ones are 0 of 9 -- the only such comparison in the record that holds the month constant. (3) THE BLACKOUT IS PROPOSED ALONGSIDE THIS as fomc-blackout-start-2027-10-16, derived from the Board's own stated ten-days-earlier rule and cross-checked against the decoded shading this repo already holds. On this meeting's dates that window runs 2027-10-16 through 2027-10-28, so the CB print at 2027-10-26 sits genuinely inside it -- unlike the September case, where the parent proposal's identical-sounding claim turned out to be arithmetically wrong. (4) THE MINUTES ARE NOT PROPOSED HERE. The Board's three-week convention, verified 42 of 45 by the fomc-minutes-2027-08-18 lane, puts them on Wednesday 2027-11-17, and that is this meeting's lane to file rather than a CB lane's to guess -- the same precedent the 08-31 and 09-28 siblings both followed. Same channel caveat as every rate entry: symbols is empty and no house playbook is rates-keyed. Proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
